issues.detail: Native Pydantic validation/coercion, constraints, relationships, derivations, pipelines and split-loader migrations are not executed by this schema projection
Native values require a separate encoder; the copied source UMF remains required for native meaning
Native table metadata remains in source without Avro interpretation; target record identity is supplied by policy
Native table metadata remains in source without Avro interpretation; target record identity is supplied by policy
Native length, formats, conversion and lexical validation are not enforced by Avro string
Selected integer width is a binding choice; the pinned Spark helper uses 32 bits and other execution rules remain source-owned
Native named-type identity, aliases, resolution and binary representation are not enforced by JSON shape validation
All declared writer fields are required in a closed JSON object; binary field ordering and runtime extra-field behavior are not reproduced
This projection defines a JSON instance binding; it does not convert Avro binary/JSON instances or implement reader/writer schema resolution
